# Bon Appétit

> > Bon Appétit is a comprehensive food and cooking platform featuring recipes, cooking techniques, restaurant guides, and culinary entertainment across multiple formats.

Bon Appétit serves as a premier destination for home cooks and food enthusiasts, offering professionally tested recipes, expert cooking advice, video content, and dining coverage. The site combines practical culinary instruction with food culture journalism and lifestyle content.

## Key Topics

- Recipes
- Cooking Techniques
- Weeknight Meals
- Comfort Food
- Home Cooking
- Restaurant Guides
- Cocktails & Drinks
- Food Culture
- Entertaining
- Baking
- Seasonal Cooking
- Culinary Travel
- Video Content
- Dinner SOS Podcast
- Jewish Cuisine

## Recipe Collections & Core Content

- [Recipes](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipes): Recipe collection hub for breakfast, lunch, dinner across all cuisines.
- [Cooking](https://www.bonappetit.com/cooking): Cooking hub with expert advice, techniques, seasonal recipes, and baking.
- [Cacio e Pepe (Classic Roman Cheese and Pepper Pasta) Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/cacio-e-pepe): Classic Roman pasta recipe with Pecorino, black pepper, cooking technique.
- [BA's Best Matzo Ball Soup Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/best-matzo-ball-soup): Classic matzo ball soup with roasted chicken broth and homemade dumplings.
- [Seafood Chowder Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/seafood-chowder): Quick seafood chowder with potatoes, fish, shellfish, silky broth.
- [Extra-Creamy Deviled Eggs Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/best-deviled-eggs): Food processor trick for creamy, smooth deviled eggs appetizer.
- [Broccoli Confetti Rice Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/broccoli-confetti-rice): Vegetarian broccoli rice dish with raisins and almonds for parties.

## Dining & Entertaining

- [Restaurants](https://www.bonappetit.com/restaurants): Restaurant guides, reviews, and dining coverage across major cities.
- [Drinks](https://www.bonappetit.com/drinks): Drinks guide featuring cocktails, wine, bars, and spirits recommendations.

## Video & Audio Content

- [Videos](https://www.bonappetit.com/video): Video content: chef profiles, cooking techniques, street food, documentaries.
- [Dinner SOS by Bon Appétit](https://www.bonappetit.com/podcast/dinner-sos): Dinner SOS podcast with Chris Morocco solving kitchen emergencies.

## Food Culture & Lifestyle

- [Culture](https://www.bonappetit.com/culture): Food culture, lifestyle, pop culture, travel, and food trends coverage.
- [Bon Appétit Culinary Getaways](https://www.bonappetit.com/story/culinary-getaways): Expert-guided culinary travel experiences in Japan, Thailand, worldwide.

## Shopping & Merchandise

- [Shopping](https://www.bonappetit.com/shopping): Product recommendations: kitchen tools, cookware, ingredients, gadgets.
- [Bon Appétit Shop](https://shop.bonappetit.com): Official merchandise store: branded apparel, kitchen items, culinary gifts.

## Optional & Reference

- [WTF Is a Weeknight Recipe?](https://www.bonappetit.com/story/what-is-a-weeknight-recipe): Editorial guide defining weeknight recipes and Bon Appétit standards.
- [7UP Cake With Lemony Glaze Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/7up-cake): Moist 7UP pound cake with citrus zest and lemony glaze.
- [No-Nonsense Matzo Balls Recipe](https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/bas-best-matzo-balls): Simple matzo balls with schmaltz, dill, black pepper, no gimmicks.
